dict.string: RecipeSlate uses AlarmKit to run cooking timers on your Lock Screen and notify you when each step is done.
RecipeSlate uses the camera to take photos of your recipes for thumbnails.
RecipeSlate uses the microphone for voice commands while cooking (say "next step" to advance hands-free).
RecipeSlate uses speech recognition to understand your cooking commands when your hands are busy.
RecipeSlate syncs your grocery list to Reminders so you can check items on your Apple Watch.
RecipeSlate creates calendar events for cooking timers longer than 24 hours.
